source_comparator_script:
import json,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('python/tools').resolve()))
from watchfiles_contracts import _native_case
from watchfiles._rust_notify import RustNotify
cases=json.loads(Path('go/testdata/python-watchfiles.json').read_text())['native_events']
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mini-loop-source-pressure-') as scratch:
    root=Path(scratch).resolve()
    warm=root/'rapid-close';warm.mkdir()
    for iteration in range(32):
        watcher=RustNotify([str(warm)],False,False,300,True,True)
        watcher.close()
    for case in cases:
        recipe={k:v for k,v in case.items() if k not in ('changed','closed','native_arguments')}
        started=time.monotonic()
        result=_native_case(root/case['name'],recipe)
        result['seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
        result['matches_pinned_fixture']=result['changed']==case['changed']
        results.append(result)
        print(json.dumps({'name':case['name'],'changed':result['changed'],'matches':result['matches_pinned_fixture'],'seconds':result['seconds']}),flush=True)
Path('/tmp/mini-loop-source-lifecycle-pressure.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rapid_close_subscriptions':32,'cases':results},indent=2)+'\n')
